David Quispe
Systems Engineer • AI Engineering & Cybersecurity
da.qc@outlook.com • Cusco, Peru (Open to Remote / Relocation) • davidquicast.github.io
github.com/davidquicast • huggingface.co/davidquicast • linkedin.com/in/davidquicast

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Systems Engineer with professional experience building AI applications, fine-tuning open-source models, and supporting
enterprise cybersecurity operations. Practical background includes developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
pipelines, tool-calling agentic workflows, and implementing vulnerability intelligence and organizational security controls
(NIST CSF, ENS, ISO 27001).

TECHNICAL SKILLS
AI & Machine Learning: PyTorch, Hugging Face, Transformers, PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA), RAG, LangChain, Langroid,
smolagents, Vector Databases (Qdrant, FAISS), Model Quantization, Synthetic Data Generation.
Cybersecurity & Cloud: Vulnerability Intelligence, Threat Intelligence (CTI), EDR Platforms, Fortinet, Microsoft 365
Defender, CCN-CERT Tools, Zero Trust Architecture.
Engineering & Systems: Python, FastAPI, Docker, SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Git, Linux/Bash, React, Laravel.
Standards & Frameworks: NIST CSF, ENS (Esquema Nacional de Seguridad), MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Top 10,
STRIDE, ISO 27001.
Languages: Spanish (Native), English (C1 Professional Working Proficiency).

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
FIAP – International and Ibero-American Foundation for Public Policy Sep 2024 – Jun 2025
Cybersecurity Technician Madrid, Spain (Hybrid)
• Spearheaded an internal vulnerability intelligence program across organizational assets to proactively detect, catalog,
and prioritize remediation of critical CVEs.
• Developed cyber threat intelligence (CTI) proof-of-concept workflows leveraging open-source LLMs and Microsoft Copilot
to automate alert triaging and IOC correlation.
• Coordinated asset inventory, security audits, and threat detection utilizing enterprise EDR and CCN-CERT security
solutions.
• Configured and hardened Fortinet firewalls and Microsoft 365 security controls, authoring organizational security policies
aligned with Spanish National Security Framework (ENS) and NIST standards.
PlawLabs Ltd. Jul 2024 – Sep 2024
AI/ML Engineer London, UK (Remote)
• Fine-tuned open-source foundation models (LLaMA-3.1 8B and 70B) utilizing parameter-efficient fine-tuning
(PEFT/QLoRA) and 4-bit quantization, merging adapter checkpoints for optimized production inference.
• Architected and deployed an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system with dense vector embeddings
and vector databases, enhancing factual grounding for domain queries.
• Built and benchmarked autonomous tool-calling agents using LangChain and Langroid; evaluated latency, cost, and
reasoning accuracy between open-weight and proprietary models.
HAMB Ingeniería y Construcción S.A.C. Jan 2022 – Sep 2022
Full Stack Web Developer (Internship) Cusco, Peru (On-site)
• Led full-stack web application development with Laravel, React, and MySQL, delivering feature enhancements that
contributed to a 25% increase in the active customer base.
• Designed and integrated SAP inventory management workflows, reducing inventory process inefficiencies by 30%.
• Rolled out enterprise CRM software and trained technical and sales teams, increasing staff productivity by 20%.

RESEARCH PUBLICATIONS & OPEN SOURCE
INCLUDE-2.0: Disentangling Knowledge Gaps in Multilingual LLM Evaluation EMNLP, Oct 2026
Coauthor (David Quispe-Castillo). Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (Main
Conference). Evaluated knowledge boundaries across multilingual LLMs, analyzing linguistic gaps in standardized benchmarks.
CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles arXiv:2610.29968, Oct 2026
Coauthor & Lead Spanish (Peru) Contributor (Cohere Labs Community collaboration). Contributed culturally grounded evaluation
instances and dialectal validation pipelines for Latin American NLP benchmarking.
Open Source AI Contributions & Model Citations
• Google DeepMind Gemma Recipes: Contributed and merged fine-tuning recipe and configuration for Gemma models
(github.com/google-gemini/gemma-cookbook).
• Hugging Face Smol Course: Authored and translated Spanish LLM reasoning, alignment, and agent notebooks
(github.com/huggingface/smol-course).
• Argilla Synthetic Data Generator: Implemented Docker and local Ollama inference integration for private offline
synthetic data workflows (github.com/argilla-io/synthetic-data-generator).
• Cited Language Benchmarks: Authored Spanish datasets KUNTUR and WikiHowES, cited by #Somos600M (Jul
2024) and RigoChat 2 (Mar 2025).

SELECTED PROJECTS
Personaxis + persona.md 2026
Open specification and command-line toolchain for declarative AI agent personas: schema validation, compiler targets, linting,
AST diffing, alongside an open agent persona registry.
Open Deep Research for Vulnerability Intelligence 2025
Autonomous cybersecurity research agent utilizing smolagents and LangChain to automate threat aggregation across NIST NVD,
Shodan CVEDB, KEVin, and EPSS APIs.
Sorry-Bench Multilingual Translation Pipeline Cohere Labs Collaboration, 2025
Automated translation and validation pipeline releasing a multilingual safety evaluation dataset on Hugging Face to benchmark
LLM jailbreak resistance across diverse languages.

Dual Higher Degree in Network Computer Systems Administration (ASIR)

Master in Cybersecurity

Postgraduate Diploma in Cybersecurity

Bachelor’s Degree in Systems Engineering
